card.title: Emotional Seniority
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who understands this relationship best, and treat your interpretation as the one that should settle disagreements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asking for your spare key back tells me we're frightened of getting closer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm frightened of paying for a third lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I understand us better than that. I'll keep the key; we need to practise trust.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then trust me with your spare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Exchanging keys is exactly the commitment I knew we were ready for.
